question: Should paired-node terminal.upload remain an internal terminal-session relay command, or become a general operator-admin node.invoke file-staging command?
rationale: The issue specifies session-bound host ownership, while the current implementation also exposes a broader standalone file-write capability; that permanent security contract requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Keep uploads session-bound
options.body: Remove terminal.upload from the general direct node.invoke surface while retaining authorization and invocation exclusively through an owned TerminalSessionManager session.

options.title: Approve standalone staging
options.body: Explicitly accept terminal.upload as a broader operator-admin node command and add dedicated authorization, documentation, compatibility tests, and security proof for that public contract.

recommendation.title: Keep uploads session-bound
recommendation.body: Remove terminal.upload from the general direct node.invoke surface while retaining authorization and invocation exclusively through an owned TerminalSessionManager session.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the linked feature direction and are the strongest available decision owner for whether this broader node capability is intentional.
